datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data with IPC classifications and scenario projections were compiled for Rwanda's near-term food security outlook in 2022, with results stored as vector features (GeoJSON/KML) linked to classification scales, collection dates, and assistance eligibility indicators.
